from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UndistributedProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's undistributed profit (未分配利润) from a financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    undistributed_profit: float | None = Field(description="Undistributed profit amount")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the undistributed profit value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    undistributed_profit_records: list[UndistributedProfitRecord]
